name: Our > Transitive > Properties
source:
Romance and mystery intertwine as a relationship develops between Sydney, the weird ex-graduate student, and Lara, the unusual girl that meets her at a local diner one strange night. As their romance develops, new secrets are revealed, and Sydney must decide how she will move forward... alone, or with Lara by her side?

[From [url=https://tinysamm.itch.io/our-transitive-properties]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奇怪的前研究生悉尼和在一个奇怪的夜晚在当地一家小餐馆遇见她的不寻常女孩劳拉之间的关系逐渐发展，浪漫与神秘交织在一起。随着他们的恋情不断发展，新的秘密也被揭开，西妮必须决定如何继续前进……独自一人，还是与劳拉一起？

[来自[url=https://tinysamm.itch.io/our-transitive-properties]itch.io[/url]]
